title: The Blood Expansion
description: This mod adds various blood related items and recipes
body:
# G's Mod
Ever feel like Netherite just is not enough? G's Mod adds two overpowered material tiers that will make the Ender Dragon wish it had stayed in bed.
## Enderite
Combine End Stone with Netherite Scrap to forge Enderite Scrap, then refine it with Emeralds into Enderite Ingots. Craft a full set of tools from there -- the Enderite Sword boasts 20 damage and a massive 2000 durability, while the Enderite Pickaxe tears through blocks at 100 efficiency.
## Blood Diamond
This one gets dark. You will need an actual Zombie Head (not just any dead zombie -go find one wearing its own face) and an Iron Sword to produce Blood Dust. Surround a Diamond with Blood Dust and you get a Blood Diamond. The Blood Diamond Sword hits for a ridiculous 50 damage, and the Blood Diamond Pickaxe mines at 1000 efficiency, turning stone into air before you can blink.
## And More
G's Mod also features a blood fluid with full bucket and brewing support, cyan bricks for builders who like teal, and two decorative blocks -- a Rubik's Cube and a GD Cube -- for anyone who wants their base to have some personality.
